source.snippet: I am working with a small travel agency based in Saudi Arabia that offers local tours and experiences (desert trips, heritage walks in AlUla and Diriyah, etc.). We are trying to understand the practical steps to make our services discoverable and bookable directly through major travel platforms (e.g., Google Things to Do, TripAdvisor experiences, GetYourGuide).

problem_statement: Small independent tour operators in emerging tourism markets (e.g., Saudi Arabia) lack a clear, practical pathway to get their inventory listed and bookable on major global OTAs and experience platforms, losing revenue to larger aggregators.
target_segment: Small tour operators and experience businesses in emerging tourism destinations (Gulf, MENA) seeking distribution on global travel platforms
notes: Asker is working with a paying agency client — business context, not hobbyist. The gap is a done-for-you OTA listing and API integration service for small operators who can't navigate technical requirements (connectivity APIs, booking system setup, content standards). Recurring revenue potential: monthly retainer for maintaining listings and syncing availability. Signal is a single post with negative score, so strength kept at 2.
